messages:
kevin: FYI — last night shard-42 fired ~200 p99 alerts in 2h. Postmortem points to threshold drift + noisy transient errors. I want a concise follow-up plan to reduce paging and own remediation. Proposal below, please claim items.

sara: I can run threshold sensitivity sims. Will validate moving from 95th->99.5th for the latency alert. Target: numbers by EOD Tue.

miguel: I’ll own dedupe/suppression tuning. Thinking a 5m suppression window keyed on shard+error_code. Will run sim and validate impact on mean time to detect.

lia: Ops suggestion: change paging policy so we only page when alert sustains for 3 occurrences within 10m or if error rate jumps >3x. That should cut flapping pages.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-20260312-42 — triggered 196 times. Linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/shard-42

kevin: Thanks — add runbook edit to action list. Also need rollback steps for each config change.

sara: quick log snippet showing spikes:
```
2026-03-12T02:13:41Z shard-42 latency=312ms error=0
2026-03-12T02:13:42Z shard-42 latency=1200ms error=1
2026-03-12T02:13:43Z shard-42 latency=325ms error=0
```
I’ll post the sensitivity table once sims finish.

miguel: proposed dedupe patch (draft):
```
alert_dedupe:
  key: "shard_id:error_code"
  window: 300s
  mode: "suppress_and_count"
```
Can someone sign off on the key choice? I prefer shard+error_code to avoid suppressing unrelated host noise.

lia: +1 for shard+error_code. For paging change, ops wants a canary rollout: 10% of pagers for 24h then 100% if stable. Schedule: Thu 03:00 UTC canary.

kevin: Approving dedupe key. Rollback plan for dedupe: revert window to 0 and emergency escalate if missed detection > 5m across root cause tests. Miguel, please document the rollback command and add to runbook.

miguel: Will add rollback snippet and tests. Rollback command:
```
kubectl apply -f alerting/config/dedupe-window-0.yaml
```

sara: Timeline recap and owners:
- Threshold sims & recommendation — sara — by Tue EOD
- Dedupe config + rollback docs — miguel — by Wed 12:00
- Paging policy change canary — lia — Thu 03:00 UTC (10% -> 24h)
- Runbook updates (detection + rollback steps) — sara/miguel — by Fri EOD

kevin: I'll do the Friday 10:00 follow-up sync and validate metrics: page count, false positives, detection latency. Add dashboards: pages/day, median time-to-detect, suppression-hit-rate.

sara: noted. I'll add a temporary dashboard panel for sims.

lia: scheduling canary and will post the canary link in this thread before rollout.

kevin: Thanks all. If nobody objects, I’ll open PRs for the alert docs template and assign reviewers: @sara @miguel. Follow-up: ping me if anything slips past timelines. :thumbsup:

sara: :thumbsup: marking action items in the postmortem tracker.

miguel: added dedupe draft to config repo: https://git.redwood/alerting/dedupe/pulls/12 — requesting review.

lia: canary scheduled and pager roster updated for Thu 03:00 UTC. I'll paste the runbook link here when ready.

kevin: last note — track recurrence pattern for 30 days post-change. If we see >2 similar incidents, we'll revisit threshold approach. Meeting scheduled: Fri 10:00 UTC follow-up (kevin, sara, miguel, lia).
